chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 75: The Storehouse – A Mind Betrayed by Silver and Sutras
chapter_meta_description: In the ruins of a bandit village, Li Huowang finds a treasure room of silver and a single book. His failure to read its title reveals a deeper, more terrifying corruption.
og_title: A Hoard of Blood and a Forgotten Word: Li Huowang’s Moment of Truth
og_description: Beyond the loot and the corpses, a simple failure of recognition becomes the chapter’s most profound horror.
twitter_title: When the world steals your ability to read, what’s left of you?
twitter_description: Li Huowang finds a fortune in silver, but the discovery of a Buddhist sutra he can no longer read is his greatest loss.
